summary: Steep cul-de-sac kerb with a house 8 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Detached house 8 m from the kerb at 14 m, more homes within 20 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Reachable and cars park here, but the slope is well over the usable limit.
drivers.convention: Residential cul-de-sac with parked cars; no signs.

sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the kerb, mainly from the north and west.
